activities.title: Producer Series: Theatre Producing 101
activities.description:
A one-day workshop focused on realistic, reasonable budget expectations for your theatre production. Learn behind-the-scenes info with real numbers, expenses you expect (royalties, theatre rentals) and those you don’t (City ticket tax, special filming licenses). Find out how to make a realistic budget and set your ticket prices so that you can pay yourself and your artists while creating work you are proud of. Led by Ian Dyer, co-owner of Good Egg Productions and Scratch Studio, and former software development product manager.

RESULT: Create a realistic budget and profit projection for your real or imagined theatre project, with assistance and fact-based numbers at your disposal.
